facts.title: 106年新進工員甄試考題(2Mb)(.PDF)
facts.reason: Complete original 20-page scanned PDF visually reviewed. It contains 10 separate two-page native booklets, including common and occupation-specific subjects, with the original category-code applicability. All booklets contain 80 selective questions with inline answer annotations. Approve only the combined question/answer role of this complete original; do not infer one occupation, a selection stage, cross-year equivalence or publication eligibility.
